Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We bridge strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a collaborative, action-oriented Project Manager to join the Total Rewards Strategy and Enablement team. In this role, you’ll lead business-critical People projects, with a primary focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Bringing an acquired business into Stripe requires coordinated work across Total Rewards, People Partners, Recruiting, People Operations, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development. You’ll project manage the People workstream from diligence and integration planning through close and post-close execution. You’ll turn deal-specific decisions into clear plans, ownership, milestones, and risk-management approaches.

You’ll coordinate functional owners across People workstreams, establish plans and dependencies, and step into the work when needed to unblock progress or close critical gaps. Your work will support transaction timelines, reduce business disruption, and create a consistent experience for acquired Stripes.

You’ll build People M&A’s capabilities through repeatable playbooks, infrastructure, and cross-training. This individual contributor role is well suited to someone who can bring structure to ambiguity and move between strategy and execution.

Responsibilities

  • Project manage People M&A workstreams from diligence and planning through close and post-close execution. Workstreams may include organizational alignment, employee data, onboarding, recruiting, and people program integration.
  • Serve as a central coordination point across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Operations, People Systems, Recruiting, People Support, Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Technology.
  • Align plans, dependencies, decisions, and accountability with transaction timelines.
  • Develop and run integration and change-management plans that give functional leads, acquired Stripes, and other affected audiences the information and support they need at each stage of a transaction.
  • Identify cross-functional dependencies, risks, and blockers early. Coordinate resolution and escalate issues when needed to protect integration timelines and the Stripe experience.
  • Establish feedback and support mechanisms for acquired Stripes, including surveys, office hours, and centralized support channels. Use feedback to improve integration plans and change-management approaches.
  • Build and improve People M&A’s infrastructure, including project plans, templates, checklists, playbooks, reporting, and retrospective documentation.
  • Build capability across People workstreams through documentation, cross-training, and shared practices that support more consistent future integrations.
  • Support other business-critical and transformational projects across Total Rewards and the People team as needed.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You have 7+ years of project or program management experience at a global company, including 2+ years project managing workstreams within the M&A lifecycle, including diligence, integration planning, close readiness, and post-close integration.
  • You have experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and building repeatable program infrastructure, such as integration playbooks, project-plan templates, readiness checklists, risk logs, or retrospective processes.
  • You have a track record of turning ambiguous problems into structured, repeatable programs. You’re comfortable building new programs in a scaling environment while improving and standardizing how work gets done.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can write a one-page executive update, a decision memo tailored to stakeholders, and a step-by-step operator playbook with equal fluency. You guide project teams through complex work in a direct, approachable, and inclusive way.
  • You can manage senior cross-functional stakeholders across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Systems, Recruiting, Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance. You know when to build alignment, raise a risk, and escalate.
  • You’re comfortable working with data and systems such as Workday and Greenhouse. You use data to clarify decisions, communicate recommendations, and define requirements with People Systems partners.
  • You focus on the experience of acquired Stripes and the teams operating the program, not only on program artifacts.
  • You can manage competing priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment. You work effectively independently and across teams, bring structure to complexity, and follow through on the details that make a program successful.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with change management frameworks, such as the Prosci ADKAR Model, and applying them to employee or operational change.
  • Project or program management certification or training, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean, Six Sigma, or a comparable methodology

The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. descriptions.job-137mwb5:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 
About the Opportunity
The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We’re a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company’s regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.
In this role, you will own OKX's Global Customer Complaints Program and report directly to the Compliance Chief of Staff. You will work closely with Local Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Risk teams to promote consistent complaint handling across jurisdictions, maintain alignment with regulatory requirements, and provide effective second-line oversight and challenge.
A key part of the role will be turning customer complaints into actionable compliance and conduct-risk intelligence. You will oversee complaints governance and quality assurance, identify trends and potential systemic issues, support root-cause analysis and remediation, and provide senior leadership with clear reporting on customer outcomes and emerging risks.
You will also support the development, coordination, and tracking of responses to regulators, working directly with Legal and Local Compliance teams on regulatory inquiries, escalated complaints, and related supervisory matters. This requires strong regulatory judgment, excellent written communication, and the ability to coordinate complex matters across multiple teams and jurisdictions.
 
What You'll Be Doing
  • Develop, coordinate, and track responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and escalated complaints, partnering with Legal and Local Compliance teams to gather and validate facts, prepare clear and defensible responses, manage review and approval processes, meet regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments, remediation, and follow-up through closure.
  • Maintain global regulatory alignment by partnering with local Heads of Compliance to identify changes in jurisdictional requirements and ensure global policies, standards, procedures, and local requirements remain current and appropriately implemented.
  • Oversee the end-to-end complaints control framework, including complaint identification and classification, regulatory and internal service-level requirements, escalation thresholds, documentation standards, investigation and resolution expectations, and closed-loop validation.
  • Own the second-line oversight and quality assurance, including risk-based testing of complaint handling, identification of control gaps and customer-outcome issues, tracking of remediation, and escalation of issues.
  • Turn complaint data into actionable compliance and conduct-risk intelligence by monitoring trends, recurring issues, root causes, regulatory complaints, overdue cases, customer outcomes, and potential systemic issues requiring broader investigation or remediation.
  • Own complaints governance and executive reporting, including reporting to compliance committees and serving as the standing owner of the complaints agenda for compliance leadership meetings.
  • Maintain the complaint management database, service level agreement adherence, and escalation thresholds across all regions.
  • Serve as the central Compliance point of contact for material complaint matters, including complaints or inquiries escalated to regulators, ensuring consistent governance, appropriate escalation, and defensible documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the framework, using QA results, regulatory developments, complaint trends, and lessons learned to strengthen controls and improve customer outcomes globally.
 
What We Look For In You
  • Strong experience developing and managing responses to regulators is required, including regulatory inquiries, information requests, examinations, escalated customer complaints, and other supervisory matters. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional inputs, develop clear and defensible written responses, manage regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments and remediation through closure.
  • Significant experience in regulatory compliance, conduct risk, consumer protection, complaints oversight, or a related discipline, ideally within a highly regulated and globally distributed organization.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or overseeing a multi-jurisdictional compliance framework, including translating regulatory requirements into scalable global standards, controls, monitoring, and governance while appropriately incorporating local requirements.
  • Strong regulatory and customer-outcome judgment, with the ability to distinguish individual service issues from matters presenting potential regulatory, conduct, consumer-harm, reputational, or systemic risk.
  • Demonstrated experience with root-cause analysis and systemic remediation, including assessing whether broader customer populations may be affected and driving appropriate corrective action.
  • Strong second-line oversight and challenge capabilities, with experience designing or operating risk-based monitoring, QA, issue escalation, remediation tracking, and governance processes.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, trend analysis, SLA monitoring, management information, and executive reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with regulators, Legal, Compliance, senior executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence geographically dispersed teams and senior stakeholders.
 
Nice-To-Haves
  • Experience designing or overseeing a global customer complaints program across multiple regulatory regimes, particularly the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, APAC, LATAM, and/or Middle East.
  • Familiarity with complaints-handling and customer protection expectations across major global regulatory regimes, including those established by the FCA, CFPB, MAS, European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, ESMA and EIOPA), and other relevant national competent authorities and dispute-resolution bodies.
  • Relevant professional certification or advanced qualification such as CAMS, CFE, CRCM, CCEP/CCEP-I, ICA compliance qualifications, CIA, CRCMP, JD or equivalent legal qualification, or a comparable compliance, risk, or audit credential.

descriptions.job-1ur1235:
About Jito


Jito builds the market layer of Solana: the execution, capital, and incentive infrastructure behind the network's onchain economy. That includes the validator client running the majority of Solana stake, BAM (a new framework for verifiable ordering, pre-execution privacy, and programmable blockspace), JitoSOL (the leading liquid staking token on Solana), and JTX (trading built directly on our own market infrastructure).

We are a lean, high-density team. Everyone here owns real surface area, works in the open, and ships at pace. The engineers on this team are the people market makers call when milliseconds matter.

About the Role
We're growing our security team and looking for an engineer who can own a broad operational and technical scope: someone equally at home triaging an access request, running a security review, or building a custom testing framework. You'll report directly to the Head of Security, working closely to strengthen and scale our security posture across the organization.

What You'll Do
• Identity and access management: provisioning, lifecycle operations, and monitoring for critical changes
• Security reviews across our product portfolio: threat modeling, code review, fuzzing, and functional testing
• Day-to-day bug bounty operations: triage, remediation tracking, and escalation of high-severity findings
• AI security research and tooling: adversarial testing frameworks for agent controls, with a focus on reusable patterns
• Software supply chain monitoring: malicious package detection beyond standard CVE scanning
• External penetration test coordination: scoping, logistics, and post-engagement remediation tracking
• Compliance documentation and evidence gathering as requirements emerge

What We're Looking For
• A software engineering background is essential: you've built production systems, and that foundation shapes how you approach security
• You've since moved into product security and are fluent in the full lifecycle: threat modeling, secure design review, whitebox code review, and vulnerability testing • 5+ years of professional experience, with a meaningful portion in software engineering before transitioning into security
• Proficiency in at least one systems or backend language (Rust preferred; Go, C++, or Python also work). You will write code, build tooling, and read production codebases as a routine part of this role.
• Demonstrated experience in product or application security, not solely infrastructure- or compliance-focused roles
• Track record of building security tooling or automation from scratch
• Experience conducting or leading security reviews on production software systems
• Solid understanding of identity and access management concepts and tooling
• Genuine interest in AI security with the ability to build adversarial testing tooling
• A thoughtful approach to software supply chain risk beyond checkbox scanning
• Strong written communication: documentation is a real part of this job
• Comfortable with high ownership and working autonomously on a small team
• Experience in web3, crypto, or DeFi
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

Nice to Have
• Hands-on experience with mobile device management (MDM) platforms and endpoint policy enforcement
• Familiarity with enterprise IAM systems and SSO: configuration, integration, and audit
• Experience with privileged access management (PAM) tooling and the operational patterns around it
• Strong Linux administration skills: comfortable at the command line, understanding of kernel-level security primitives, experience hardening Linux environments
• Experience with multisig schemes: signing policy design, quorum configuration, or key management in a production context
• Familiarity with hardware security modules (HSMs): integration, key lifecycle management, or operational use
• Exposure to trusted execution environments (TEEs): attestation, confidential compute, or secure enclave design

How we work


Remote-first, writing-heavy, and transparent by default: most decisions happen in public Slack channels, and everyone's voice carries. We value ownership, humility, curiosity, and getting it done over getting it perfect. Small egos, high standards.


What we offer


Competitive compensation including salary and token incentives, the tools you need to do your best work, and a seat at the center of Solana's market infrastructure alongside some of the strongest engineers in the ecosystem.

Jito is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on the basis of their skills, experience, and potential contribution, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the company
 
Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.
 
Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

As a Backend Engineer on Ondo's market making team, you'll build and scale the infrastructure behind our trading stack - real-time systems that quote and hedge tokenized markets 24/7 across on-chain and traditional venues. This is a small, senior team, working in Rust and Go, with high ownership over live production risk.

You'll work across systems that manage pricing, execution, and PnL accounting, integrating market data from both traditional venues and on-chain sources. You'll collaborate closely with the trading and infrastructure teams to define robust interfaces and deliver systems that hold up under real-time, high-throughput conditions.

This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of Web2 and Web3, in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement low-latency backend systems and APIs for quoting, hedging, and executing across on-chain and traditional trading venues.
  • Collaborate with the trading team to define interfaces and workflows between pricing, execution, and market data services.
  • Own integrations with market data providers, exchanges, and on-chain venues, including feed handling and order execution.
  • Build reconciliation and data-integrity tooling so positions, fills, and PnL stay consistent across live trading state.
  • Establish and enforce backend engineering standards, best practices, and security protocols across the stack.
  • Participate in code reviews and architecture discussions, contributing to a culture of engineering excellence.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of backend software engineering experience, with strong programming ability in Go or Rust, and willingness to work in both.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, system design, and building services that run under real-time or latency-sensitive conditions.
  • Experience integrating with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), third-party services, and high-throughput, production-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated interest in Web3, DeFi, or trading systems—whether through professional experience or side projects.
  • Familiarity with market microstructure or order execution is a plus, but not required.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup environment with high ambiguity and high ownership over live production risk.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with market data providers and protocols (Databento, SIP/prop equity feeds, venue WebSocket APIs).
  • Prior work on trading systems, execution infrastructure, or market data infrastructure at a trading firm, exchange, or broker.
  • Exposure to crypto venues and on-chain trading.
 
What we offer
 
• Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation
• Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)
• Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices
• A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom
• Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures
descriptions.job-0jlfck1:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 

About the team:

Web Presence & Platform (WPP) is organized into two pillars: Platform and Presence. The Platform pillar builds internal systems, tooling, and infrastructure to support the web. The Presence pillar owns Stripe’s public-facing storytelling across stripe.com, including our homepage, product landing pages, industry and solutions pages, and other high-impact go-to-market surfaces. Together, we shape how millions of people understand what Stripe is and what it can do for them.

Designers on the Presence team work at the intersection of craft and impact—balancing clarity, polish, and systems thinking with strategic storytelling and experimentation. We collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, content, and product to deliver work that is not only beautiful, but measurably moves the business.

 

What you’ll do

As a Designer on the Presence team, you'll contribute to the strategy and execution of Stripe’s most visible web surfaces. You’ll design new product pages, evolve storytelling for specific industries or audiences, and refine reusable patterns that make it easier to scale exceptional work across stripe.com. This is a high-impact role for a thoughtful, collaborative designer who deeply values visual craft, user clarity, and iteration.

We’re looking for someone who’s excited to operate at the intersection of storytelling, systems, and scale—and who takes pride in the pixels. Your work will directly shape how millions of users understand Stripe, and help convert interest into action across a range of audiences—from founders to enterprise CTOs.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design new and improved experiences across stripe.com, including product, industry, and solution landing pages
  • Collaborate with engineers, PMMs, and content designers to define problems, explore solutions, and bring them to life
  • Partner with other designers to maintain and evolve systems that uphold Stripe’s design standards at scale
  • Balance storytelling with usability to create pages that are engaging, credible, and easy to navigate
  • Use user research, user testing, and data to guide and validate your decisions
  • Participate in critique and feedback sessions, contributing to the overall quality bar of the team
  • Demonstrate a meticulous attention to craft—ensuring designs are not only functional, but visually excellent

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification.

Minimum requirements

  • 2–4 years of relevant design experience, ideally in web or product marketing contexts
  • A strong portfolio of web design work that demonstrates exceptional visual design skills, systems thinking, and attention to detail
  • Ability to independently scope and lead small to medium-sized projects
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
  • Fluency in layout, typography, color, hierarchy, and interaction fundamentals
  • Comfortable using Figma and working in component-based systems
  • Experience working on CMS-driven websites and modular systems

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with front-end development workflows or an ability to speak fluently with engineers
  • Understanding of web performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices
  • Experience designing for international audiences or multilingual websites
  • Previous experience in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

How we work

We care deeply about craft—but also about moving with urgency and focus. We seek feedback early and often, because we believe design gets stronger through collaboration and iteration. We keep our users front and center—whether that’s a small business owner evaluating Stripe for the first time, or a CTO trying to understand a complex product at a glance. And we take pride in delivering work that is not only beautiful and precise, but that delivers clear, measurable impact.

We value curiosity, humility, and resilience. You’ll do well here if you love to learn, enjoy working across disciplines, and bring energy and optimism into your work.

This is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow. Designers on the Presence team have gone on to lead major product launches, shape system-wide improvements, and take on leadership roles. You'll be supported by experienced peers and have space to develop your craft, influence, and ownership over time.

descriptions.job-01o4zo1:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the role

Ramp is building a new AI business, and you’ll be one of its first technical sellers. Your job is to turn technically complex AI products into closed revenue.

You’ll sell a growing portfolio spanning AI-powered applications and agents for finance teams, as well as infrastructure that helps companies deploy and manage AI with greater control, security, and cost efficiency. This is a product-focused, quota-carrying technical sales role. You’ll help customers evaluate and purchase Ramp’s AI products, translating complex capabilities into clear business value and guiding opportunities from discovery through close.

This is a high-velocity commercial role, not a traditional pre-sales position where success ends with a great demo. You’ll be accountable for turning technical evaluations into commercial wins from start to finish. You’ll lead discovery, shape deal strategy, build executive-level business cases, deliver tailored demonstrations, navigate technical and commercial objections, and create urgency around a clear path to purchase.

You’ll move comfortably between technical and executive conversations. In one meeting, you may discuss model routing, APIs, integrations, data governance, and security with Engineering and IT teams. In the next, you may help Finance and executive leaders understand the ROI, total cost of ownership, and operational impact of adopting Ramp’s AI products.

You’ll join at a formative moment for Ramp’s AI business. As one of the first dedicated sellers for these products, you’ll help identify the strongest use cases, refine how we position and sell the portfolio, influence the customer experience, and build the playbook the broader team will eventually scale. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle from discovery and evaluation through close, implementation, and adoption, helping customers translate their purchase into a successful deployment. This role combines Ramp’s resources and customer reach with the ownership, speed, and ambiguity of an early-stage team.

What you’ll do

  • Carry a revenue quota and own the progression of AI product opportunities from initial discovery through purchase, ensuring business value is clear, technical requirements are validated, and obstacles to a decision are resolved.

  • Lead discovery with business and technical buyers to understand their goals, workflows, challenges, decision criteria, existing systems, and AI strategy.

  • Translate Ramp’s AI applications and infrastructure into compelling solution narratives tied to measurable business outcomes.

  • Build ROI and total cost of ownership analyses that quantify the value of Ramp’s AI products and create executive-level justification for investment.

  • Help customers identify high-value use cases, set realistic expectations, and establish a credible path from evaluation to production.

  • Deliver tailored demonstrations, technical workshops, and proofs of concept with clear success criteria that establish value and build confidence in a purchase decision.

  • Build relationships with champions and decision-makers across Engineering, IT, Security, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and executive leadership.

  • Navigate questions related to APIs, integrations, model capabilities and limitations, data flows, architecture, privacy, security, governance, implementation, and tradeoffs among quality, cost, latency, and control.

  • Apply strong commercial judgment to qualify opportunities, create urgency, address objections, identify risk, and keep customers moving toward a decision.

  • Lead customers through implementation after purchase, including deployment planning, stakeholder alignment, workflow design, technical coordination, enablement, and adoption.

  • Partner with Account Executives and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Security, Marketing, and post-sales teams to remove deployment blockers and deliver a strong customer experience from evaluation through production.

  • Bring structured customer and market feedback to internal teams to improve the products, positioning, sales execution, and customer experience.

  • Turn early customer conversations into repeatable messaging, demonstrations, qualification criteria, value stories, and sales plays as we build this go-to-market motion from the ground up.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, technical sales, Solutions Architecture, enterprise software sales, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Direct quota-carrying or deal-closing ownership of the pre-sale cycle—not only experience delivering demonstrations or supporting post-sale implementation.

  • A track record of independently influencing and winning complex B2B sales opportunities with clear revenue accountability.

  • Strong discovery and value-selling skills, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to build executive-level business cases, including ROI and total cost of ownership analyses; this capability will be central to success in the role.

  • Commercial instincts and comfort taking meaningful ownership of deal strategy, momentum, and results.

  • Technical fluency across modern AI systems, including applications and agents, model capabilities and limitations, APIs, integrations, data flows, security, governance, and tradeoffs among quality, cost, latency, and control.

  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex concepts clear and relevant to different audiences.

  • The ability to explain probabilistic, rapidly evolving AI technology with credibility and precision without overpromising what the product can do.

  • Experience building champions and navigating multi-threaded buying groups with competing priorities.

  • High ownership, curiosity, sound judgment, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where you’ll build structure as you go rather than inherit it.

  • Energy for zero-to-one work and the opportunity to build a sales motion rather than simply inherit one.

Nice to have

  • Experience helping launch a new product or develop an early go-to-market motion.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.
You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.

  • Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.
  • Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.
  • Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.

Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.

Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..

What We Look For In You

Who we are

Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We bring deep technical and industry knowledge to complex customer opportunities, advise the broader pre-sales organisation, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, and provide critical market insight to Stripe’s product and engineering teams.

This role will be Stripe’s dedicated Payments and Optimised Checkout specialist in APAC. Based in Singapore, you will support complex and strategic opportunities across Southeast Asia, Australia/New Zealand, and Greater China particularly those involving Managed Payments, Adaptive Pricing, Optimised Checkout Suite (OCS), multi-currency payments, and local payment methods.

As an early specialist hire in-region, you will have significant autonomy to shape how Stripe brings these solutions to market across APAC. You will report into a global team outside the region, so success in this role requires strong self-direction, excellent communication, and comfort operating through ambiguity.

What You’ll Do

You will partner closely with product, sales and core pre-sales teams to progress strategic opportunities, drive pipeline and revenue, and help customers design high-performing payment experiences. You will act as a trusted technical and business advisor to senior customer stakeholders, translating complex payment infrastructure into practical architectures and measurable business outcomes.

You will use your payments expertise to help enterprises improve authorization and conversion rates, expand across markets, simplify payment operations, manage cost and risk, and deliver better local customer experiences. You will also scale your impact by developing reusable APAC-specific assets, reference architectures, and sales plays.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex enterprise customer engagements from discovery through solution design, implementation planning, and measurement of business impact across Managed Payments, Adaptive Pricing, OCS, and local payment methods.
  • Advise customers on scalable payments architecture, including payment orchestration, multi-currency flows, cards, wallets, local payment methods, fraud and risk systems, and money-movement rails.
  • Conduct deep discovery with business and technical stakeholders, develop solution scopes and reference architectures, and guide trade-offs across conversion, authorization, cost, risk, customer experience, and implementation complexity.
  • Act as an APAC payments thought leader by bringing regional market insight including cross-border and local payment-method considerations to customers, sales teams, and Stripe’s product and engineering organizations.
  • Scale the broader organization through reusable APAC assets, customer workshops, coaching on strategic opportunities, and collaboration with internal teams and customers across the region; travel approximately 25% as needed.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in payments, fintech, financial services, or a related technology industry, including designing payment solutions or financial architectures for enterprise customers.
  • Deep knowledge of payment flows and payments architecture, including cards, wallets, local payment methods, multi-currency payments, payment orchestration, fraud and risk systems, money movement, and relevant ISO payment standards.
  • Experience advising large B2B and/or B2C enterprises on payment modernization, checkout optimisation, conversion and authorization improvement, cost optimisation, network compliance, or processing reliability.
  • Strong understanding of the APAC payments landscape and cross-border payment considerations
  • Strong project management, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to work independently through ambiguity; professional fluency in English and Business Mandarin to conduct business and technical conversations with stakeholders across SEA, ANZ and Greater China

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Stripe or integrating RESTful APIs into web or mobile applications.
  • Experience with Optimised Checkout, payment orchestration, adaptive payment-routing approaches, or checkout-conversion optimisation.
  • Experience with online payments, marketplaces, subscriptions, platforms, or multi-party money movement.
  • Experience working in a pre-sales, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or payments-specialist role.
  • Experience building a new regional function, creating repeatable operating practices, or succeeding as an early in-region hire within a globally distributed organisation.
descriptions.job-0lifuc1:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

Team & Job Summary:

As a Customer Solutions Engineer at TRM Labs, you own the technical relationship with our US federal and national-security customers — from the first discovery call through live deployment. You will propose business processes and technical architectures, demonstrate and customize the TRM platform, integrate TRM APIs into mission workflows, and support customers in succeeding with our solutions. Your success is measured both by the outcomes customers achieve on the platform and by the expertise you feed back into the Solutions Engineering team.

The impact you will have:

  • Own and deliver end-to-end TRM solutions, from understanding complex customer requirements to designing advanced business processes, customizing the platform, integrating TRM APIs, and conducting testing and training for maximum customer impact.

  • Act as the go-to technical consultant during discovery calls with key customers and prospects, documenting intricate technical requirements and guiding solution design.

  • Present TRM's APIs and architecture, providing detailed guidance on implementation, timelines, and potential challenges, while ensuring alignment with the customer's strategic goals.

  • Develop and maintain high-quality resources for customer integrations — API documentation, reference architectures, and implementation guides — so onboarding gets faster for every customer after this one.

  • Cultivate strong relationships with technical stakeholders, providing expert-level support throughout the integration process and troubleshooting issues as they arise.

  • Stay current with TRM's evolving product features and technical dependencies to keep customer needs and the product roadmap aligned, advocating for enhancements when necessary.

What we’re looking for:

  • Professional experience in pre- and post-sales roles, such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer.

  • US Citizenship is required for this position (no dual citizenship), driven by our US federal customer base.

  • Exceptional customer-facing skills, with the ability to empathize with both technical and non-technical audiences and demonstrate how complex solutions meet their business goals.

  • Proven experience collaborating with engineering and product teams to customize API-based SaaS products at scale, including implementation, testing, and launch.

  • Comfortable scripting in one or more languages to build PoCs for customers or prototype APIs (e.g. Python, JavaScript, TypeScript).

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple complex tasks independently while maintaining attention to detail.

  • High initiative and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for improvement, both in technical solutions and in team processes.

  • Bonus: previous experience in AI development is highly preferred.

About the Team:

  • Solutions Engineering at TRM is a globally distributed, fully remote team that thrives on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation.

  • As a globally distributed team, members may observe different timezones — most of the team overlaps between 8:00am and 5:00pm ET for meetings and collaboration.

  • We are on the front lines of TRM: experts in our craft, focused on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors.

  • What we learn in the field goes back into the product — this team is a primary source of customer insight for engineering and product.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Weekly Customer Syncs

  • Bi-weekly health syncs

  • Associated POD calls with the account team

  • Regular direct engagement with customers

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: core overlap 8:00am–5:00pm ET

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: No formal on-call rotation. Occasional off-hours availability during live mission operations.

  • Frequency: Ad hoc — no pager and no 24/7 obligation.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Remote-first, US-based

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Timely documentation: You will deliver integration documents within 1–2 days by prioritizing tasks, reusing existing content, and focusing strictly on the document's goal.

  • Immediate contingency solutions: You will resolve urgent customer issues by quickly assessing the situation and providing immediate alternatives — like manually exporting critical data if a fix takes longer.

  • Fast proof of concept: You will put a working scripted PoC in front of a customer within days of understanding the requirement, rather than waiting on an engineering cycle.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Meet some of the people you'd be working with. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

In collaboration with the IT team and other departments, we foster a culture of security awareness, sharing best practices and ensuring that everyone at MoonPay understands their role in maintaining a secure environment.

What You Will Do

    • Set and maintain security standards for SaaS apps, integrations, APIs, plugins, and automation platforms.

    • Assess new applications and integrations before approval, reviewing architecture, data flows, and trust boundaries.

    • Assess AI assistants and third-party AI integrations accessing company systems.

    • Detects and reduces shadow IT and unsanctioned SaaS-to-SaaS connections.

  • Threat modeling and secure design

    • Facilitate risk-based threat modeling for SaaS apps, integrations, APIs, scripts, and internal tools.

    • Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, and sensitive-data exposure; ensure risks have owners, mitigations, and timelines.

    • Provide secure design alternatives when proposed solutions create unacceptable risk.

    • Maintain reusable threat models and review checklists for common integration patterns.

  • Script and automation security

    • Review Python, JavaScript, shell, and low-code/no-code automations for secrets handling, injection risks, unsafe data processing, and excessive permissions.

    • Promote centralized secrets management, short-lived credentials, and least privilege.

    • Build automated checks for exposed secrets and insecure configurations.

  • Perform targeted testing of integrations, APIs, identity flows, and configurations.

  • Vendor / Third-Party Security

  • L2 Incident Response (Operational Role) 

    • Monitor SaaS environments for suspicious activity, unauthorized integrations, and data-leakage risks

    • Actively participate in Security Operations activities as an L2 Incident Responder.

    • Lead incidents through all stages: identification, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned. 

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for the SOC regarding SIEM investigations, platform behavior, detection logic, and operational troubleshooting.

    • Support continuous improvement by translating incident learnings into better detections, dashboards, and playbooks.

    • Experience assessing security and access controls in collaboration/SaaS tools such as Linear, Slack, Notion, Intercom, and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence)

Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Data Engineering team at Paxos builds and maintains the data infrastructure that powers our engineering partners and analytics teams, providing scalable, reliable, and secure data access for product analytics, business intelligence, client and regulatory reporting, and operational efficiencies. You'll join a small, high-impact group of engineers across US and India time zones, working with teams across the company to continuously enhance our data platform, driving innovation, optimizing costs, and unlocking new revenue opportunities.

About the role

The Data Platform Engineer at Paxos serves as an owner of key parts of our data platform, from design through production operation. Depending on the problem, your work may span data pipelines, streaming systems, data lakes and warehouses, databases, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, automation, security, or governance. You will turn ambiguous needs into reliable, maintainable systems and take responsibility for their operational outcomes. We're looking for strong engineering fundamentals, deep experience in at least one relevant area, sound technical judgment, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly. You don't need experience with every part of our stack: a strong engineer with Spark experience is welcome even though we don't currently use it, because what matters is how you've designed, scaled, and operated data systems.

What you’ll do

  • Own data-platform projects end to end: clarify the problem, evaluate alternatives, design the system, implement and roll it out safely, document it, and operate it in production.

  • Design and evolve reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective systems for data ingestion, movement, storage, processing, and access.

  • Build and improve batch and streaming pipelines and the platform capabilities that support them.

  • Develop maintainable software, automation, infrastructure, and CI/CD workflows that make platform changes safer and more repeatable.

  • Improve observability, performance, capacity management, incident response, recovery, and operational readiness across the platform.

  • Incorporate security, access control, data protection, and governance requirements into platform design and delivery.

  • Partner with engineering, analytics, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to understand needs, explain tradeoffs, and deliver pragmatic solutions.

  • Evaluate and learn new technologies as platform needs evolve, applying sound engineering judgment rather than defaulting to a familiar tool.

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, design, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while critically validating the output.

  • Contribute to technical direction, design reviews, documentation, and mentoring across a small, high-impact team working across US and India time zones.

About you

  • A record of independently owning and delivering substantial production systems or platform work from definition through operation.

  • Strong system-design and problem-solving skills, including the ability to reason about scale, reliability, failure modes, security, cost, maintainability, and migration tradeoffs.

  • Deep production experience in at least one relevant area, such as data pipelines and ingestion, distributed batch or stream processing, Kafka or similar messaging systems, data lakes or warehouses, time-series databases, PostgreSQL or other operational stores, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language and experience writing, testing, reviewing, and operating maintainable production code.

  • Practical experience with automation, production operations, observability, incident response, and safe software or infrastructure delivery.

  • Demonstrated learning agility: you have successfully become productive in unfamiliar technologies or domains and can do so without heavy day-to-day direction.

  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate asynchronously across teams and time zones.

  • Active, responsible use of AI tools in your engineering workflow, paired with strong validation and independent technical judgment.

You might also have

  • Experience with one or more technologies in our current environment, such as Snowflake, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, PostgreSQL, Terraform/Terragrunt, dbt, Dagster, data lakes or open table formats, or time-series databases.

  • Experience designing or operating high-volume ingestion, change-data-capture, batch-processing, or event-streaming systems.

  • Experience building cloud infrastructure, internal platforms, reusable infrastructure modules, or developer tooling.

  • Experience with data governance, security, access control, classification, masking, lineage, or identity integrations.

  • Experience working in fintech, banking, payments, healthcare, or another regulated or security-sensitive environment.

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!
descriptions.job-05cq49d:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

The Client Services Specialist is a critical role responsible for ensuring the operational excellence and seamless experience of DriveWealth's global B2B clients. This role oversees the daily operational support functions, acting as the primary escalation point for complex inquiries related to the API-based investing platform. Success in this role means not only resolving client issues quickly and accurately but also strengthening operational processes and ensuring regulatory adherence. This role works cross-functionally particularly with Client Onboarding, Engineering, and Compliance, to implement a scalable and world-class support model. They will own the documentation and refinement of support workflows, directly contributing to client satisfaction and the firm's overall stability.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for escalated support inquiries from clients, ensuring timely, accurate, and service-oriented responses.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot client-reported issues by collaborating cross-functionally with Client Growth, Product, Engineering, and Operations.
  • Triage incoming cases, assess urgency, and escalate further when necessary, maintaining thorough and organized case documentation to track status, trends, and client feedback.
  • Build strong rapport with clients by providing consistent, high-quality support and proactive communication.
  • Identify patterns across inquiries to recommend process improvements, workflow updates, and product enhancements.
  • Support the development of client-facing Help Center content, FAQs, and internal documentation to reduce recurring escalations.
  • Contribute to ongoing client enablement by helping refine training materials, onboarding flows, and operational guides.
  • Work cross-functionally with Client Onboarding and Relationship Management teams to create a seamless support model for current and future clients.
  • Create a collaborative working relationship with the Engineering team to enhance the automation of back-office systems and workflows.
  • Conduct meetings with the Compliance and Legal Departments to review, maintain, and update the firm's written supervisory procedures related to operational support and applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
  • Participate in weekend support coverage (at least one weekend day ongoing).

You Bring

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in Financial Services and/or Fintech, with specific experience in self-clearing, omnibus clearing, or correspondent clearing relationships.
  • Active Series 7 required and the ability to obtain Series 24
  • A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes environments
  • The ability to prioritize ruthlessly, focussing on what’s critical versus important to drive work to completion
  • A client-oriented mindset with an understanding of how your work impacts clients
  • Strength in cross-functional partnership with the judgment to coordinate across multiple teams
  • A bias toward transparency, accountability, and responsiveness in everything you do
  • You’re committed to continuous improvement and implicitly believe that we > I. 
  • Impeccable high integrity, sound judgment, and a deep respect for risk, control, and operational excellence
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant subject (e.g., Finance, Business, Technology) or equivalent experience.

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following location: Chicago, Ilinois

  • This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $90,000 – $100,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Marketing Counsel at SDF is a high-impact role at the center of how SDF shows up to the world. You will partner across Marketing, Communications, Product, Business Development, Ecosystem, Policy, and Legal to help teams move quickly while keeping external messaging, campaigns, grants, product launches, events, brand protection, and partner-facing work aligned with SDF’s legal, regulatory, reputational, and mission-driven priorities. In this role, you will:

  • Own legal review for SDF’s outward-facing marketing and communications materials across channels, including social, web, mobile, PR, blogs, digital ads, decks, FAQs, event collateral, scripts, product explainers, disclosures, and early-stage campaign concepts.

  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with comfort partnering across business teams.

  • Experience drafting, reviewing, or negotiating marketing, advertising, SaaS, services, event, sponsorship, strategic partnership, grant, or similar commercial agreements.

  • Interest in SDF’s mission and curiosity about blockchain, digital assets, payments, and open-source technology. Prior blockchain or crypto experience is helpful, but strong marketing and advertising legal judgment is more important.

About Hex Trust

Hex Trust is a fully-licensed and regulated financial institution for digital assets. We hold licenses in Dubai (VARA) and Singapore (MAS), are registered in Hong Kong (TCSP), and operate 24/7 from offices in Hong Kong, Singapore, Dubai, and Vietnam.

We are an integrated provider of custody, trading, financing, staking, and tokenization services. Our custody platform, Hex Safe, is one of the strongest in the market and serves 600+ institutional clients globally: investors and allocators (VCs, funds, family offices), Web3 companies (foundations, protocols, token issuers), and service providers (wealth managers, OTC desks, brokers, PSPs, corporates, banks).  It stands out as the only platform offering regulated cold wallets with transaction signing under 1 second, compared to an industry average of around 2 hours. 

As a pioneer in digital asset infrastructure, we are now expanding our ecosystem by strategically entering the payments’ business space.  This expansion marks a pivotal milestone in our growth, aimed at bridging traditional finance with the digital economy through compliant, scalable and instant payment infrastructure. 

Position Summary

We offer an attractive, formula-based, uncapped bonus structure tied directly to originated revenue, paid quarterly.

We are looking for a VP / Director Senior Sales for Cross-border Payments Solutions with a strong network across the payments and PSP ecosystem in APAC and the GCC. The ideal candidate has sold payment infrastructure into institutional clients, understands how PSPs and fintechs make integration decisions, and can speak credibly about stablecoins, on/off-ramps, settlement, and APIs.

As a Senior Payments specialist, you will help spearhead Hex Trust's strategic expansion, transforming our core enterprise capabilities into cutting-edge merchant solutions and global digital payment networks.

This role carries two mandates:

  1. Scale our existing Convert-to-Pay business by originating and closing PSP, acquirer, and fintech clients across APAC and the GCC — driving payment volume, recurring revenue, and stickiness from day one.
  2. Secure a flagship design partner to co-develop the next generation of programmable stablecoin payment infrastructure — a strategic, build-the-future mandate at the frontier of where payments and digital assets are heading.

This is a pure origination role with high autonomy and direct impact on revenue. You will own the commercial cycle end-to-end: prospecting, structuring, closing, integration coordination, and ongoing client coverage. The platform is proven, the licenses are real, and we have the right to win.

  • Own the full commercial cycle for Convert-to-Pay: prospecting, qualification, structuring, closing, integration coordination, and ongoing client coverage across APAC and the GCC.
  • Identify and win new PSP, acquirer, fintech, and payment-infrastructure clients to grow stablecoin payment volume, recurring revenue, and assets in flow — this is a hunting role.
